name: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Limited
about: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of paper and paper products in India and internationally. It offers newsprint paper, writing and printing/wood free printing paper, high strength unbleached kraft paper, white bleached kraft paper, black kraft paper, insulating kraft paper, interleaving paper, greaseproof paper, glassine paper, baking paper, thermal sensitive paper, print base paper, textile/sublimation paper, bible paper, release paper, and eco-friendly paper packaging solutions. The company was formerly known as Bansal Paper Mills and changed its name to Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Limited in 1986. Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in New Delhi, India.
